program_code = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    objects = []
    for color in sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}):
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1 - r0 < 2 or c1 - c0 < 2:
            continue
        if not (all(grid[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) and
                all(grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) and
                all(grid[r][c0] == color for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)) and
                all(grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0, r1 + 1))):
            continue
        pattern = [[grid[r][c] == color for c in range(c0 + 1, c1)]
                   for r in range(r0 + 1, r1)]
        objects.append((color, r0, r1, c0, c1, pattern))

    sources = [o for o in objects if any(any(row) for row in o[5])]
    if not sources:
        return out
    # The patterned frame provides the template for all frames with matching interiors.
    source = sources[0]
    sh, sw = len(source[5]), len(source[5][0])
    for color, r0, r1, c0, c1, pattern in objects:
        if (color, r0, r1, c0, c1) == source[:5]:
            continue
        ih, iw = r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1
        if (ih, iw) != (sh, sw):
            # Incompatible empty frames are removed.
            for r in range(r0, r1+1):
                for c in range(c0, c1+1):
                    if out[r][c] == color:
                        out[r][c] = 0
        else:
            for r in range(r0+1, r1):
                for c in range(c0+1, c1):
                    out[r][c] = color if source[5][r-r0-1][c-c0-1] else 0
    return out
'''
